description: `given n` in `match name { … }` with no `n` in scope is E-SCOPE-001 — `given` narrows an existing variable, it binds nothing (S462 review F3).
rationale: §42.2.3: "`given` narrows in place; it does NOT rebind to a new name … A `given` head SHALL contain only an identifier-list" and its match-arm form is `given x :> handlePresence(x)` with `x` the scrutinee. The arm used to compile and throw `ReferenceError: n is not defined` at page init.
